independent_code_review.overlap: Independent checks overlap the combined suite and are not additive.

limits: Source qualification using existing offline fixtures and provider mocks; no new production or live provider workload.
Canonical speech input and returned-byte playback acknowledgment are checked, not waveform/text semantic alignment or human comprehension.
Raw even PCM EOF cannot itself establish complete narration.
Host outcome denominator is current admitted action slots, not lifetime actions or final bank resolution.
Exact workflow-turn/query attribution, card-block lifetime joins and operational dollar-cost measurement remain outside this change.
Source qualification does not update earlier live recordings, audits or deployment identities.
